notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Recorded the voice over sounds for the game this weekend and added most of them in. Promptly added sound controls and a save system to make sure any global settings are respected when the game is loaded. Continuing to fix lots of bugs found by Teddy during his "playtest". 

Also added in 15 achievements for release including "completionist" for gaining all 15. 

Release is looking like the 3rd week of November but there is a lot to do! More updates soon.
